<!--
This issue is public. Do not include personal e-mail addresses, phone numbers or secrets.

**Who you are**
Your team or company, and your role.

**What you want agents to work on**
A sentence or two: the product, the kind of work, the repository if you can name it.

**Your team**
How many people, and which of these fits best: founder or small product team, engineering lead
adopting coding agents, services firm or support shop.

**Anything else**
Any constraint to know about, such as where code may run.
